name: Tenants
overview: The Scriptures portray tenants, or husbandmen, who fail in their stewardship of the vineyard, representing God's provision and blessings. The parables in Matthew 21:41, Mark 12:9, and Luke 20:16 reveal that the wicked tenants will be destroyed and the vineyard given to others who will bear fruit in due season. This judgment underscores God's righteous response to unfaithfulness and the transfer of responsibility to those who will honor His purposes.
